title: Rory and the Velvet Clover Cove
verses:
The sun tumbled down past the edge of the sky,
While evening flew in as the shadows rolled by.
Then Rory stepped softly along through the dew,
Where clover grew thick in a blanket of blue.

High over the treetops did Nia swoop low,
To show them a hollow where night-breezes blow.
And Psittaco chirped from a branch in the air,
To tell all his friends of the bed waiting there.

Quick Ricky dashed forward with bouncy delight,
Then slowed to a tiptoe to welcome the night.
While Tilly nudged clover to pile on a mound,
And padded the petals all over the ground.

Then Benny bent down with a rumble so deep,
To make a warm circle for dinosaurs' sleep.
And Rory scooped blossoms to tuck in the space,
So everyone found a soft, comforting place.

The silver stars sparkled through branches above,
And wrapped the whole valley in quiet and love.
Then Psittaco snuggled by Nia's warm wing,
And listened to crickets begin now to sing.

Now Rory leaned back with a velvety sigh,
As moonlight hummed low from the dome of the sky.
Each heavy head rested, so cozy and still,
While dreams drifted over the starry green hill.
